verdict: FALSIFIED - the save-acceptance layer is not complete. Two persisted claim classes no authored writer can produce are accepted by both gates and mint live economy effects at restore.

evidence.probe_result: 6/6 pass (all four defect assertions + two controls)

findings.claim: save.equipment carries no array-length bound; every per-entry check (slot, grade, quality, mainStat roll bound, affix envelope/dup, forgeUses) passes on the forged payload.
findings.writer_inventory: EquipmentBag.add() is the only writer; it runs autoDissolveOverflow() at pickup, so a legitimately-produced bag (and therefore a legitimate save) can never exceed EQUIPMENT_BAG_SOFT_CAP = 500 items. A >500-entry payload is unproducible by construction.
findings.repro: 505 valid unprotected entries (registered itemId, authored slot, equipped:false, quality 'tien') pass validateGameSaveShape AND assertSaveAcceptable.
findings.mint_path: validateGameSaveShape -> assertSaveAcceptable -> SaveSystem.restore -> GameManagerSaveRestore.ts:281-301 equipmentBag.add() per entry -> EquipmentBag.autoDissolveOverflow() dissolves the 5 excess items -> AutoDissolveReward -> materialBag.add(LUYEN_KHI_TINH_HOA_ID, 5 x ITEM_QUALITY_ESSENCE_RANGE.tien.min = 25 essence). Repeatable per crafted save injection.
findings.scale: payout scales linearly with forged excess count; quality 'tien' maximizes per-item essence (min 5)

findings.claim: save.buildings validates each entry (shape, level <= maxLevel, level <= realm tier, accrualRealmId pin <= player realm) but never deduplicates on buildingId or instanceId.
findings.writer_inventory: Every building template is category 'crafting_station'; canBuildDetailed returns 'already_built' for a second same-buildingId instance, so the sole writer can never produce duplicates.
findings.repro: Two entries { instanceId: 'b-1'/'b-2', buildingId: 'gathering_outpost', level: 1, lastCollectedAt: 0 } pass both acceptance gates.
findings.mint_path: validateGameSaveShape -> assertSaveAcceptable -> restore -> BuildingManager.restore maps entries verbatim (no dedupe) -> BuildingSystem.claim(instanceId) pays floor(min(elapsed x rate, capacity)) per instance -> collectBuilding credits materialBag per forged instance. N duplicates = N x authored accrual payout.
findings.scale: linear in forged instance count; per-instance payout capped by authored level-1 capacity window
